string-array.name: notif_gentle_messages
string-array.item: Save your work and close. Your time starts now.
Your shift is over. You\'re allowed to stop too.
You can leave something for tomorrow.
Shut the laptop. Pick up the rest calmly later.
You have an appointment with everything else. Unplug.
Time to stand up and change the view.
You can call it a day. Even without finishing everything.

string-array.name: notif_friendly_messages
string-array.item: That doesn\'t look like a shutdown screen.
“I\'ll finish this and close.” We\'ve heard that one before, right?
Your to-do list isn\'t going anywhere. Sadly.
Try closing the laptop. The rest of your day opens up.
Doing nothing is a perfectly respectable plan.
The mouse can stay home alone. It\'s a big mouse now.
The couch needs no updates. Consider switching.
Work has had your attention. Now give it to someone else.
It has a sister. Don\'t meet the whole family.

string-array.name: notif_insistent_messages
string-array.item: “Just one more thing” is not a clock-out time.
Save the file. Don\'t open another one to celebrate.
Work is asking for an encore. You bring down the curtain.
You don\'t need to finish the list to finish the day.
You\'re stretching work and shrinking everything else.
Even the charger knows when to unplug. Take notes.
That comma can wait. You can get up.
The close button works even with things left to do.
This is the reminder. The next step is yours.
Boarding for your evening is about to close.
If it were, it wouldn\'t come by email.
Not everything. Just one: the laptop.

string-array.name: notif_aggressive_messages
string-array.item: You can leave the desk. You weren\'t sold as a set.
Your last email has had more sequels than a movie franchise.
The laptop doesn\'t love you. Close it.
You turned “almost done” into a long-term project.
The chair is not adopting you. Get up.
You don\'t need to guard the file. It won\'t escape.
Are you working, or waiting for the desk to grow wheels?
You don\'t need to call a meeting to close everything.
Working from home doesn\'t mean living in the keyboard.
You already said goodbye. Now follow through.

string-array.name: notif_nuclear_messages
string-array.item: You\'ve won more work. Claim your prize by closing everything.
Your superpower? Turning free time into backlog.
You\'re harder to close than a frozen program.
You\'re becoming a desk accessory. Without even a warranty.
You\'ve made everything flexible, except quitting time.
Work never ends. You could set a good example.
All you need now is an inventory number. Get up before they assign one.
You just added “unplugging” to the things you put off.
That file is called “final”. I wish I had your optimism.
If excuses to stay paid, you could retire by now.
Remote working or house arrest? Try stepping away.

string-array.name: notif_apocalypse_messages
string-array.item: You\'re the most expensive paperweight in the office. You can go.
At least the hamster has a wheel. You have Excel.
An app is lecturing you. And you\'re staying for the sequel.
Work waits for anyone. They\'re waiting for you.
It won again today. Tomorrow, at least put up a fight.
Your “one last thing” now has its own to-do list.
It left a message: “I exist outside office hours too.”
You planned everything except your exit.
It airs live just once. No reruns.
What will it take to move you: a deadline or a removal van?
It\'s been waiting for hours with one question: “What\'s for dinner?”
You\'re waiting for the end credits of a spreadsheet.
Close everything. You can skip the acceptance speech.
